Package com.sc.demo.sse.examples.ordermanagement

Class OrderManagementController

java.lang.Object
com.sc.demo.sse.examples.ordermanagement.OrderManagementController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1") @CrossOrigin(origins={"http://localhost:5500","http://127.0.0.1:5500"}) public class OrderManagementController extends Object
HTTP API for creating orders and subscribing to their status updates.

The create endpoint returns the new order ID as plain text. A client then uses that ID to open an text/event-stream subscription.

  • Method Details

    • createOrder

      @PostMapping("/create-order") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> createOrder(@RequestBody OrderRequest orderRequest)
      Validates and accepts an order for asynchronous processing.

      Requests with a quantity above 100 receive 400 Bad Request. The service validates the remaining fields. On acceptance, the response body contains the order ID that clients use to subscribe to updates.

      Parameters:
      orderRequest - item, positive quantity, and delivery address
      Returns:
      HTTP 202 and the generated order ID, or HTTP 400 for an excessive quantity

    • updateOrder

      Opens an SSE connection for updates associated with one order.
      Parameters:
      orderId - identifier returned by createOrder(OrderRequest)
      Returns:
      the long-lived event stream for this client
